import hashlib,json,math,time
from pathlib import Path
import torch,numpy as np
from _impl.models import load_checkpoint,initialize
from _impl.io import digest
initialize();start=time.monotonic()
out=Path("outputs/coupled_pair_geometry_20261026");out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
model=load_checkpoint("MNIST/finetuned.pt");state=model.state_dict()
ref=Path("outputs/phase2_task_subspace_comparison_20261020/basis.pt")
assert digest(ref)=="99b5f25e7868dd8fd1e9712cf2cca37600f470e8345f5782869e9a0d67d71344"
entries={r["source_key"]:r for r in torch.load(ref,map_location="cpu",weights_only=False).values()}
rows=[]
for i in range(12):
 p=f"model.visual.transformer.resblocks.{i}.mlp."
 A,B,a=[state[p+k].double().cuda() for k in ["c_fc.weight","c_proj.weight","c_fc.bias"]]
 V=entries[p+"c_fc.weight"]["v"].cuda()
 N=torch.linalg.qr(V,mode="complete").Q[:,32:]
 M=torch.cat([A,a[:,None]],dim=1)
 Q,R=torch.linalg.qr(M,mode="reduced")
 Mp=torch.linalg.solve_triangular(R,Q.T,upper=True)
 sv=torch.linalg.svdvals(R);assert float(sv[-1])>torch.finfo(torch.double).eps*max(M.shape)*float(sv[0])
 U=B@A@N;W=N.T@Mp[:768]
 Ap=A-2*(A@N)@N.T
 Bp=B-2*U@W
 target=B@M;changed=Bp@torch.cat([Ap,a[:,None]],dim=1)
 rel=float((changed-target).norm()/(1+target.norm()))
 assert rel<1e-9
 first=float((Ap-A).norm()/A.norm())
 d=float((Bp-B).norm()/B.norm())
 bound=2*min(float(U.norm()*torch.linalg.matrix_norm(W,ord=2)),
              float(torch.linalg.matrix_norm(U,ord=2)*W.norm()))/float(B.norm())
 row=dict(layer=i,augmented_rank=len(sv),condition_number=float(sv[0]/sv[-1]),
   affine_product_relative_error=rel,initial_relative_A_change=first,
   all_iterates_relative_A_lower_bound=math.sqrt(2)*float((A@N).norm()/A.norm()),
   all_iterates_relative_A_upper_bound=2*float((A@N).norm()/A.norm()),
   initial_relative_B_change=d,analytic_locked_B_bound=bound,
   declared_total_relative_B_bound=math.sqrt(bound**2+1),
   task_A_parameter_relative_error=float(((Ap-A)@V).norm()/(Ap-A).norm()),
   inverse_equation_error=float((Mp@M-torch.eye(769,device="cuda")).norm()),
   null_space_fixed_dimension=3072-769)
 if i in [0,11]:
  aa,bb,aaa,nn=[v.cpu().numpy() for v in [A,B,a,N]]
  mm=np.column_stack([aa,aaa]);q,r=np.linalg.qr(mm,mode="reduced");mp=np.linalg.solve(r,q.T)
  aa2=aa-2*(aa@nn)@nn.T;bb2=bb-2*(bb@aa@nn)@(nn.T@mp[:768])
  value=np.linalg.norm(bb2@np.column_stack([aa2,aaa])-bb@mm)/(1+np.linalg.norm(bb@mm))
  row["independent_numpy_product_error"]=float(value)
  row["numpy_torch_B_relative_error"]=float(np.linalg.norm(bb2-Bp.cpu().numpy())/(1+np.linalg.norm(bb2)))
  assert value<1e-9 and row["numpy_torch_B_relative_error"]<1e-9
 rows.append(row);print("COUPLED_GEOMETRY",json.dumps(row),flush=True)
x=dict(status="original_weight_joint_affine_condition_only",rows=rows,source_images=0,new_real_images=0,
 new_defense_points=0,parameter_updates=0,new_AGA_calls=0,seconds=time.monotonic()-start,
 basis_sha256=digest(ref),scope="A-variable input mixing and B-variable synchronous affine compensation. Even QuickGELU component still changes;not a full-function symmetry,not a global residual rotation,not a natural utility or fusion result. Pseudoinverse/Cayley/linearconstraints areknown,not innovationclaims.")
(out/"results.json").write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2)+"\n")
print("COUPLED_GEOMETRY_DONE",x["seconds"],flush=True)
